_doc: PASTE AND A LOCKED TARGET -- the cross-language family for
transcripts/LAYER_STRUCTURE.md 15 (RULED by JYH 2026-07-28).
THE PRINCIPLE: refuse when the ARTIST chose the target, divert when the
FRAGMENT chose it.
* Plain Paste (R2) targets the ACTIVE layer, which the artist picked.
A locked active layer therefore REFUSES: nothing lands, the document
is byte-identical, and no undo step is recorded.
* Preserving Paste (R3) targets a layer the INCOMING FRAGMENT named.
A locked target DIVERTS to a numerically suffixed sibling -- 'Sky'
locked gives 'Sky 2' -- because the artist asked for STRUCTURE, not
for that particular layer.
* HIDDEN IS NOT LOCKED. Hidden is a visibility state, not a protection,
so a hidden target is appended to normally and the artist unhides.
The asymmetry with lock is deliberate.
WHY THIS FAMILY COULD NOT EXIST BEFORE 2026-07-28: every case is seeded
from a setup_svg, and until LOCKSVG (13.1) the SVG codec dropped
`common.locked` in both active ports. paste_layers.json's own _doc still
records 'WHAT THIS FAMILY CANNOT REACH: appending into a LOCKED or HIDDEN
matching layer ... no setup_svg can produce a locked layer'. jas:locked
retired that sentence and this family is what replaces it.
THE THREE SETUP DOCUMENTS (SVG px -> document pt is x3/4):
paste_locked_active_layer.svg   [0] 'Sky' LOCKED and ACTIVE, [1] 'Ground'
paste_locked_named_layer.svg    [0] 'Ground' ACTIVE, [1] 'Sky' LOCKED,
[2] 'Sky 2' open -- the suffix already taken
paste_hidden_named_layer.svg    [0] 'Ground' ACTIVE, [1] 'Sky', both open;
visibility does NOT survive SVG in either
port, so the hidden state is produced by
driving select_element + hide_selection
rather than seeded
HOW THE GOLDENS ARE IMPLEMENTATION-INDEPENDENT, which is what let this
family go RED IN BOTH PORTS AT ONCE. Not one golden here was generated
from the behaviour it is meant to pin:
* every REFUSAL points at its own family's SETUP golden by FILE
IDENTITY, so 'the document is unchanged' is asserted against the
document itself and cannot drift into a golden that merely looks
unchanged;
* every DIVERT points at a CONTROL case's golden by file identity. The
control pastes a fragment layer literally named 'Sky 2' into the same
setup, which is behaviour this ruling does not touch. So the divert is
pinned as an EQUATION -- diverting from a locked 'Sky' must produce
exactly what naming the sibling outright would have produced -- rather
than as a snapshot of the code that implements it.
WHAT THIS FAMILY DOES NOT REACH. The refusal's VISIBLE half: `paste` and
`paste_in_place` now carry `!active_document.active_layer_locked` in their
`enabled_when`, and that is watched by the menu_state corpus, not here. An
ACTIVE message on top of the greyed item is NOT built and NOT decided --
name: paste_locked_family_setup_is_a_locked_active_sky_over_an_open_ground

_doc: THE HEADLINE REFUSAL. R2 targets the ACTIVE layer, which is locked. Nothing lands. The golden is the SETUP golden, by file identity.
name: plain_paste_into_a_locked_active_layer_refuses_and_changes_nothing

_doc: THE SUFFIX WALK, and the reason it is a WALK rather than a mint. 'Sky' is locked, so the divert looks at 'Sky 2' -- which already exists and is OPEN, so the artwork APPENDS into it and NO new layer is created. Minting 'Sky 3' instead would make every repeat of one paste manufacture another layer, which is the proliferation the verbatim-naming rule exists to avoid.
name: preserving_paste_of_a_locked_named_layer_appends_into_the_existing_numeric_sibling

_doc: Setup for the HIDDEN vectors: 'Sky' at [1] is hidden by driving the production seam (select_element then hide_selection) because visibility does not survive the SVG codec in either port. It is hidden, and it is NOT locked.
name: paste_hidden_family_setup_hides_sky_without_locking_it

_doc: HIDDEN IS NOT LOCKED, on the R3 path. The named target is hidden, so the fragment is APPENDED INTO IT -- no divert, no new layer, and its visibility is left invisible for the artist to unhide. Diverting here would manufacture a layer to avoid a condition that protects nothing.
name: preserving_paste_of_a_hidden_named_layer_appends_into_it_and_creates_nothing
